spans.s:
Sprinkled.
2

Illumined.
n. (-तं)
1 Ghee, clarified butter, or butter which has been boiled gently, and allowed to cool: it is then used for culinary and religious purposes, and is highly esteemed by the

Hindus.
2

Water.
f. (-ता)
The name of a tree: see घृतमण्डा.
E.
घृ to sprinkle, Uṇādi affix क्त.

f. (-री)
The aloe, (Aloes perfoliata.)
E.
घृत ghee, to which the extract is compared, and कुमारी a virgin, which the plant is supposed to resemble in delicacy and elegance; also घृतकुमारिका.

m. (-म्भः)
A jar of ghee.
E.
घृत, and कुम्भ a jar.

m. (-तिः)
The deity of fire.
E.
घृत ghee, and दीधिति light; offerings to fire, always comprehending clarified butter.

m. (-शुः)
Ghee made into or supposed to resemble an animal to be offered at a sacrifice or eaten at a meal, for which it is substituted.
E.
घृत, and पशु an animal.

m. (-रः)
A sweetmeat composed of flour, milk, cocoanut and ghee, &c.
E.
घृत ghee, and पूर what is full of.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Galedupa arborea, &c.): see करञ्ज.
E.
घृत ghee, and पूर्ण full, कन् added.

m. (-शः)
Swallowing ghee.
E.
घृत, and प्राश eating.

n. (-नं)
Tasting or swallowing ghee.
E.
घृत, and प्राशन eating.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sprinkled or smeared with ghee.
E.
घृत and प्लुत bathed.

f. (-ण्डा)
A tree; also वायसोली.
E.
घृत, and मण्ड scum; the scum of its infusion resembling ghee.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Mixed with ghee, steeped in it or wet with it, &c.
E.
घृत, लोल desirous, कृत made, च्चि augment.

m. (-रः)
A sweetmeat, or flour, &c. baked with ghee and sugar.
E.
घृत, and वर what excels.

m. (-यी)
A vender of ghee.
E.
घृत, विक्रय to sell, इनि aff.

mfn. (-स्पृक्)
Who or what touches ghee.
E.
घृत, स्पृश to touch, क्विन् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Smeared with ghee.
E.
घृत, and अक्त smeared.

f. (-ची)
One of the Apsaras or courtezans of Svarga.
E.
घृत ghee, अञ्च to worship, क्विप् and ङीप् affs.

f. (-वा)
Large cardamoms.
E.
घृताची, गर्म्भ the womb, and सम्भव born from.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Smeared or anointed with ghee.
E.
घृत, and अभ्यक्त anointed.

m. (-ह्वः)
Turpentine.
E.
घृत ghee, and आहूआ an appellation, named from ghee.

f. (-ली)
A cockroach.
E.
घृत ghee, इर to go, घञ् affix, र changed to ल, fem. affix ङीप्.

m. (-दः)
The sea of ghee surrounding Kusa Dvīpa.
E.
घृत, and उद water.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A leather vessel holding ghee.
E.
घृत, उद up, अञ्च to go, affix घञ्.
